Priya: quick sync / short follow-up to RFC: proposing a signed-intent handoff for dedicated-pool autoscale + eviction. posting the core flow for feedback.

Anya: high level?

Priya: CP computes intents (burst_credit, reserve_fraction, eviction_profile) -> signs -> push to operator. Operator validates local safety rules and either APPLYs or REJECTs with reason. REJECT triggers fallback to pinned_policy.

Leo: how to avoid CP/agent drift?

Priya: intents have short TTL (default 2m) and include a small node_snapshot sample. operator rejects if snapshot stale or divergence > threshold. intent rejection emits reason and trace_id.

SRE-Alex: need structured events for DECISION_APPLY / DECISION_REJECT and a queryable index in logs/console. Also include trace_id on every eviction decision.

Priya: agreed. example enums for eviction_profile: EVICT_COLD, EVICT_HOT_SWAP, EVICT_FORCE. profile fields: grace_sec, reclaim_pct (0-100), reserved_gpu_floor.

Anya: prefer adding absolute gpu_cap to avoid weird math on tiny pools. Also add confidence level for inferred reserves.

Priya: good. canary plan: 1) dry-run on synthetic tenants (5% traffic) 2) dry-run on opt-in real tenants 3) enforce on low-traffic pools 48h 4) staged ramp with operator dampeners.

SRE-Alex: operator dampeners = max_delta_reclaim_pct_per_hour, min_reserved_gpu_floor, enforcement_backoff_ms. Also auto-rollback if tail latency >2x baseline for 10m. Add chaos tests: node kill + traffic spike + control plane pause.

Leo: metrics we need: per-tenant amortized_gpu_seconds, intent_apply_latency, intent_rejection_rate, predicted_vs_actual_evictions.

Priya: rollout checklist: enums/proto, operator safety gates, structured events + dashboards, canary harness + chaos, billing mapping fractional->units, RFC follow-up + runbook. Opening branch rfc/autoscale-handoff-7432. OpsBot: branch created.

OpsBot: CI queued for rfc/autoscale-handoff-7432.

Anya: I'll pair with Leo for the canary harness. Priya, please add SLO table for intent_apply times in RFC.

Priya: will do. closing for now, will push draft. :rocket:
